purpose: Interface microcopy for the AOP viewer — page title, search placeholder, calendar/POI empty + loading states, and the hot-button labels. index.html applies these on load (window.AOP_UI) and falls back to the literal in code if this file is missing, so wording lives here as reviewable data. Entries under *_reference are NOT wired yet — they are still set in the markup at the noted location and are listed here only so the copy-review page can show them.

poi.empty: No places loaded yet. Toggle layers in the right panel, or wait for the map to finish loading.

install_reference._where: index.html #pavIosHint / #pwaIosHint markup; contains <b> tags, kept in markup.
install_reference.ios_steps: To install: tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.

controls_reference._where: index.html control-cluster markup; static button text.
